activities.label: Model
activities.title: Product rule in products
activities.body: Read the model and note the two parts of the rule.

essentialIdeas: Differentiate a product by using the derivative of the first factor times the second, plus the first factor times the derivative of the second.

activities.label: Explain
activities.title: Say the product rule
activities.body: In one or two sentences, explain the rule in your own words. Keep it closed-note.
activities.concept: Product rule
activities.correctAnswer: For a product of two functions, differentiate the first times the second, then add the first times the derivative of the second.
activities.feedback: A complete answer names both terms in the product rule and shows that both factors are treated symmetrically.

activities.label: Model
activities.title: Chain rule for composites
activities.body: Read the model and note the outside-inside structure.

essentialIdeas: Differentiate a composite function by taking the derivative of the outer function and then multiplying by the derivative of the inner function.

activities.label: Repair
activities.title: Fix the inner derivative step
activities.body: Correct the missing step in the rule from memory.
activities.misconceptionSummary: Treating the outer derivative as the whole answer and forgetting the inner derivative factor.
activities.concept: Chain rule
activities.correctAnswer: Take the derivative of the outer function, then multiply by the derivative of the inner function.
activities.feedback: The corrected rule must keep the inner derivative factor. That factor is what makes a composite function different from a simple outer derivative.

activities.label: Reexplain
activities.title: Explain the chain rule again
activities.body: Explain the chain rule again in plain language, without copying the model.
activities.concept: Chain rule
activities.correctAnswer: When a function is inside another function, differentiate the outside first and multiply by the derivative of the inside.
activities.feedback: A complete response makes the outside-inside structure explicit and includes the multiplying step.

activities.label: Check
activities.title: Pick the rule for a product
activities.body: Choose the correct rule for a new derivative situation.
activities.concept: Product rule
choices: Differentiate the first factor and multiply by the second, then add the first factor times the derivative of the second.
Differentiate the first factor, then ignore the second factor.
Differentiate both factors and multiply the results.
activities.correctAnswer: Differentiate the first factor and multiply by the second, then add the first factor times the derivative of the second.
activities.feedback: The product rule uses two terms, not one, and it keeps both original factors in the result.
